_note: Item l (small shifts in location or date). Each card lists the same answers for the chosen time moved by time_offsets_hours, and — for sites with a LOLA terrain skyline — for points location_offset_km away in each direction (local north/east/south/west). scripts/shifts.py computes the skylines of those points with the same method as data/horizon/; the Sun/Earth angles at those points are computed in the browser (Astronomy Engine, as for own coordinates).
